pages.title: Events and relay messages
pages.summary: The signed event is the common language of Nostr. Parse it, recompute its id, then check its signature.
pages.coverage: Coax reads and verifies events, matches filters, reads standard tags and metadata, and builds signed events. The NIP-01 page runs five real verification cases.
pages.gap: Live project pages still trust the configured relay. Production signing keys wait for the secret audit and independent review.
pages.demo_scope: The captured event and altered copies run through the shared event reader and signature verifier.

pages.title: Deletion requests
pages.summary: Authors can ask relays to delete their own events. A deletion request is a signed event, not a command from any reader.
pages.coverage: The production relay advertises NIP-09. Its Coax replacement does not yet implement deletion and tombstones.
pages.gap: Coax needs authorized deletion, durable tombstones and recovery that cannot resurrect deleted events.
pages.demo_scope: This demo reads a frozen public NIP-11 capability document. It does not execute this NIP on a relay.

pages.title: Replies and threads
pages.summary: An e tag can mark a root, reply or mention. These markers describe the thread rather than granting authority.
pages.coverage: Coax reads the root, reply and mention markers of standard event tags.
pages.gap: Reading a reference does not verify the referenced event or implement an entire social client.
pages.demo_scope: A public synthetic tag fixture runs through the shared standard-tag reader. No event signature is checked here.

pages.title: Relay information
pages.summary: Before subscribing, a client can ask a relay which protocols and limits it declares.
pages.coverage: The Coax relay serves its own NIP-11 document. The production relay publishes a separate capability document.
pages.gap: A supported_nips list is a declaration, not a conformance proof. Production and Coax relay capabilities differ.
pages.demo_scope: This demo reads a frozen public NIP-11 capability document. It does not execute this NIP on a relay.

pages.title: Private messages
pages.summary: Private messages compose signed and encrypted envelopes. Relays transport ciphertext rather than a public plaintext conversation.
pages.coverage: The production relay advertises NIP-17. The browser encrypted-deck path already uses the existing NIP-44 and gift-wrap plumbing.
pages.gap: A complete shared Coax private-message client and its NIP-59 composition remain unfinished.
pages.demo_scope: This demo reads a frozen public NIP-11 capability document. It does not execute this NIP on a relay.

pages.title: Names people can share
pages.summary: npub, note, nprofile, nevent and naddr turn keys and references into checksummed strings.
pages.coverage: Coax encodes and decodes the NIP-19 forms, including bounded TLV references and relay hints. Project pages use the public forms.
pages.gap: A checksum catches damaged text. It does not authenticate a person, relay hint or referenced event.
pages.demo_scope: A public example runs through the shared NIP-19 decoder, including checksum and output-size refusals.

pages.title: Comments with explicit scope
pages.summary: A comment names its root and parent. Uppercase scope tags and lowercase parent tags make that relationship explicit.
pages.coverage: Coax has a typed reader for kind 1111 comments and the task-plan, claim and revision tags OpenAgents uses with them.
pages.gap: The typed reader reads structure. Callers still verify the original signature and decide whose comments count.
pages.demo_scope: Synthetic comment tags run through the shared typed reader. Scope shape is not signature or permission.

pages.title: Relay-based groups
pages.summary: A relay can host groups with membership, moderation and group-specific rules.
pages.coverage: The production relay advertises NIP-29. The shared Coax relay has not reached group-policy parity.
pages.gap: Group membership, moderation, history visibility and permission checks need their own qualified Coax implementation.
pages.demo_scope: This demo reads a frozen public NIP-11 capability document. It does not execute this NIP on a relay.

pages.title: Git repositories and issues
pages.summary: Repository announcements, issues and status events let development work travel as signed Nostr records.
pages.coverage: OpenAgents publishes its work on Nostr. Coax has typed readers for repository, issue and status records, plus OpenAgents project and ordering records.
pages.gap: Typed extraction and signature verification are separate. Project scope, allowed authors and complete live folding remain consumer responsibilities.
pages.demo_scope: Synthetic repository tags run through the shared typed reader. It does not verify an event signature.

pages.title: Event expiration
pages.summary: An expiration tag limits how long a relay should serve an event. The exact expiry second is already expired.
pages.coverage: The Coax relay checks expiration during admission and queries. Its store retains expired replacement heads so older versions do not return.
pages.gap: Expiration is not a deletion guarantee, and a relay cannot erase copies held elsewhere.
pages.demo_scope: The shared relay expiration predicate runs at explicit fixture times. No event is published or deleted.

pages.title: Authenticate to a relay
pages.summary: A relay sends a fresh challenge. The client signs a kind 22242 event bound to that relay and connection.
pages.coverage: Coax handles challenges, canonical relay URLs, event templates, signature checks, connection generations and AUTH routing.
pages.gap: The demo builds an unsigned fixture template. It does not sign or send an AUTH event. Real keys remain behind the review gate.
pages.demo_scope: The shared challenge/template functions run on public fixtures. No key is entered and no AUTH is sent.

pages.title: Version 2 encryption
pages.summary: A conversation key derives message keys. The receiver checks the MAC before releasing decrypted plaintext.
pages.coverage: Coax implements NIP-44 v2 payload encryption and decryption, and conversation-key derivation from validated x-only ECDH.
pages.gap: These public test vectors are not permission to enter real keys. Production secret use still needs audit, target evidence and independent review.
pages.demo_scope: The shared decryptor reads a pinned upstream public vector. Changed or truncated ciphertext must refuse.

pages.title: Count matching events
pages.summary: A COUNT request asks a relay how many events match a filter without downloading every event.
pages.coverage: The production relay advertises NIP-45. The Coax R1 relay currently reports COUNT as unsupported.
pages.gap: COUNT responses and their limits need a Coax implementation before that relay advertises this NIP.
pages.demo_scope: This demo reads a frozen public NIP-11 capability document. It does not execute this NIP on a relay.

pages.title: Encrypted key backup foundations
pages.summary: Password-protected key backup needs a costly KDF, a complete encrypted format, and careful memory and key handling.
pages.coverage: Coax has a resumable scrypt foundation for NIP-49, bounded workspaces and independent vector checks. This page exercises its buffer-admission helper.
pages.gap: The complete ncryptsec backup format, normalization, secret erasure and production approval are not established. This is a partial foundation.
pages.demo_scope: The existing scrypt buffer-admission helper checks public fixture addresses and sizes. No password is derived.

pages.title: Search a relay
pages.summary: A search filter asks a relay to match text according to its supported search behavior.
pages.coverage: The production relay advertises NIP-50 search. The Coax replacement has not implemented its search behavior.
pages.gap: Search semantics, query cost, ordering and compatibility need differential tests before a Coax cutover.
pages.demo_scope: This demo reads a frozen public NIP-11 capability document. It does not execute this NIP on a relay.

pages.title: Gift wraps
pages.summary: Gift wraps layer a rumor, a signed seal and an outer encrypted envelope, using fresh wrapping keys.
pages.coverage: The existing browser encrypted-deck path uses NIP-59 plumbing, and the production relay advertises NIP-59.
pages.gap: The shared Coax gift-wrap and seal composition is not implemented. NIP-44 primitives alone do not finish NIP-59.
pages.demo_scope: This demo reads a frozen public NIP-11 capability document. It does not execute this NIP on a relay.

pages.title: Relay list metadata
pages.summary: A user can publish the relays they read from and write to, so peers know where to look.
pages.coverage: The production relay advertises NIP-65. Pylon planning includes publishing its selected relays as a NIP-65 list.
pages.gap: The capability declaration does not establish a complete Coax outbox-discovery or multi-relay synchronization client.
pages.demo_scope: This demo reads a frozen public NIP-11 capability document. It does not execute this NIP on a relay.

pages.title: Relay pagination metadata
pages.summary: A relay can attach metadata to EOSE so a client can distinguish more available history from a finished page.
pages.coverage: The production relay advertises NIP-67 and sends trailing EOSE metadata. Coax message.coax accepts bounded trailing EOSE values.
pages.gap: Parsing metadata is not proof of complete history. Catch-up still needs explicit limits, ties, retries and missing-record handling.
pages.demo_scope: This demo reads a frozen public NIP-11 capability document. It does not execute this NIP on a relay.

pages.title: Protected events
pages.summary: A protected event may only be published by its authenticated author, when a relay supports accepting it.
pages.coverage: The production relay advertises NIP-70. The Coax relay has AUTH plumbing but not this complete protected-event policy.
pages.gap: AUTH alone does not implement NIP-70. The event author must be bound to the authenticated connection under the protected-event rules.
pages.demo_scope: This demo reads a frozen public NIP-11 capability document. It does not execute this NIP on a relay.

pages.title: Efficient synchronization
pages.summary: Negentropy helps peers find differences between event sets without downloading the whole shared history.
pages.coverage: The production relay advertises NIP-77. The Coax replacement roadmap includes a separate synchronization implementation.
pages.gap: The shared Coax stack does not yet provide NIP-77 reconciliation. EOSE and ordinary pagination are different mechanisms.
pages.demo_scope: This demo reads a frozen public NIP-11 capability document. It does not execute this NIP on a relay.

pages.title: File metadata
pages.summary: A signed file-metadata event describes a file and its location, hash, type and related hints.
pages.coverage: The production relay advertises NIP-94 and can carry file metadata records.
pages.gap: The shared Coax stack has no complete file-metadata consumer or download-integrity flow yet. A signed URL does not establish file availability.
pages.demo_scope: This demo reads a frozen public NIP-11 capability document. It does not execute this NIP on a relay.

pages.title: Authenticate an HTTP request
pages.summary: A signed kind 27235 event can bind an HTTP method, URL, timestamp and optional body digest to a request.
pages.coverage: Coax has tag extraction and a public request-field observer. The existing service and production relay advertise HTTP-auth capability.
pages.gap: The demo compares supplied fields only. It does not verify an event, reserve replay IDs, authorize a request or create a session.
pages.demo_scope: The existing observer compares public fixture fields. Matching fields are not authenticated HTTP access.
